quests.title: Count the Tools Back In
quests.text: A load of tools has come back from the front, and its dispatch record is waiting at the forge yard's loading apron here in Dur Brannoc. Check the returned load against that record so I can arrange repairs and replacements. 'Most of it' may satisfy a carter in a hurry; it does not tell a smith how many handles to fit.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft DO1 (K1 A): the town place of Dur Brannoc's forge yard (chapter 1's, another label); the Accord's third 41-50 giver (capitals are budget-exempt).

quests.title: Readable in the Rain
quests.text: The front sends back labels with the destination rubbed off and the word 'urgent' wonderfully preserved. Bring me ten sheets of Paper for fresh labels on the tools and supplies. I intend to send the next load somewhere more precise than Urgent.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft DO2: Paper, a Basic recipe.

quests.title: A Footing for Repairs
quests.text: The repair crews need to know where the damaged aqueduct can still support their work. Use the sighting frame at {name:r20_anchor_080} to judge the last sound footing, and report your findings to me. I can arrange tools and hands from Dur Brannoc once I know they have somewhere to stand.
quests.lesson: A free front task of the giver's own people (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft DO3: a use at the free clash site 080; Dur Brannoc's weapon (a solo quest).

quests.title: Optional: A Blank on the Chart
quests.text: Our chart leaves the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/spires} {dir_from_giver:front_wyrmglass_crown/spires} blank, which offends me as a dwarf and as a keeper of records. Reach the Wyrmglass Crown by boat; the Shipwright at our stables sells them, and the crossing is safe on the shelf and the channel, away from the Kraken's deep water. Kill six Spire Eagles on those spires by day so a surveyor can look at the stone without being pecked for it.
quests.lesson: Island trip by boat; coin at the cap, no XP.

quests.title: Party: Silence for the Clan
quests.text: {name:rime_bell_warden} tolls over the {name:front_wyrmglass_crown/spires} {dir_from_giver:rime_bell_warden}, and the clan wants that bell silenced. That golem is an elite: gather a full party, take a boat each to the Wyrmglass Crown and break it. I've a payment ready and a space in the record for everyone who comes back.
quests.lesson: Optional group elite on the island.

quests.title: Optional: No Claim on the Crown
quests.text: A branded coin has been wedged into the survey cairn at {name:r20_anchor_075} on The Wyrmglass Crown, as though a capstone could sign away an island. Take a boat from the Shipwright at our stables, follow the shelf and channel, and pry the brand-coin out of the cairn. The clan paid for a survey; it did not authorise a sale.

objectives.label: Pry the brand-coin from the survey cairn

quests.lesson: Optional island extension of the main line (chapter 3 on): one use, coin only.
quests.notes: Round 62 FRONTQUESTS. Draft DO6: the optional island use, free from 60 without a story prerequisite.
